hooks.command: if command -v tci >/dev/null 2>&1; then tci hook session-start; else echo '{"systemMessage":"This repository records which behavior each code change implements, using tci, but tci is not on your PATH. Nothing is being recorded in this session. See the repository README for how to get it."}'; fi # tci
if command -v tci >/dev/null 2>&1; then tci hook prompt; fi # tci
if command -v tci >/dev/null 2>&1; then tci hook pre-tool; fi # tci
if command -v tci >/dev/null 2>&1; then tci hook post-tool; fi # tci
if command -v tci >/dev/null 2>&1; then tci hook stop; fi # tci
if command -v tci >/dev/null 2>&1; then tci hook subagent-start; fi # tci
if command -v tci >/dev/null 2>&1; then tci hook subagent-stop; fi # tci
